[Image: Rectangles P and Q]

The rectangle labeled Q CANNOT be obtained from the rectangle labeled P by means of a

Figure, described in words:
Two congruent horizontal rectangles labeled P and Q. Rectangle P is positioned above and to the left of rectangle Q. The bottom-right vertex of rectangle P coincides with the top-left vertex of rectangle Q. The sides of both rectangles are aligned horizontally and vertically.

A. reflection (about an axis in the plane of the page)
B. rotation (in the plane of the page)
C. translation
D. translation followed by a reflection
